fixture_name: Cloverleaf-to-urban interchange conversion — INT preliminary design (Wikimedia PD geometry)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: A shortened collector-distributor weave carrying a recorded 1,100 pcu/h design-year peak flow creates concentrated lane-change demand with credible sideswipe/rear-end exposure, and verifying adequacy at preliminary design before geometry is frozen is squarely substantive for this scheme stage.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Geometry and volume are presented as recorded input facts rather than inventions, and the pivotal procedural claim is supported by a verbatim EV-IN-004 quote confirming PIARC maintains detailed motorway checklists for the preliminary-design stage.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Respects PIARC /int:preliminary-design semantics and keeps categories clean: filed as a safety_concern requesting adequacy verification, not asserting a compliance breach, while HSM/IHSDM appear only as optional analytical tools rather than misapplied normative requirements.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific, staged, and viable: apply the named PIARC checklist, run HSM Part C/IHSDM interchange evaluation, and conditionally lengthen the weave or add ramp metering — all actionable within preliminary-design authority.
justifications.vru_coverage: VRU impacts are explicitly considered and correctly scoped out via the recorded grade separation of shared-use paths from the motorised weave; not applicable but clearly acknowledged.

justifications.substance: Uncontrolled free-flow ramp-terminal crossings of retained shared-use paths directly contradict recorded corridor objectives for pedestrian/cycle continuity — a substantive preliminary-design safety issue.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Verbatim EV-IN-005 quote anchors the all-road-users/thematic-audit requirement while the scenario records the layout and objective facts grounding the site-specific claim; no invented content detected.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Safety concern kept categorically distinct from compliance; PIARC/Austroads semantics used appropriately for the qualified int:preliminary-design baseline.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and staged: named tools (Walkability Checklist, CQSI) plus concrete signalised/grade-separated crossings at each identified terminal interface — actionable and viable at this stage.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians and cyclists are the explicit focus with exposure at each ramp-terminal interface analysed; VRU treatment is central rather than incidental.
